title: helichrysum × selago var. intermedium
intro: Helichrysum × selago var. intermedium, commonly known as Helichrysum ciliatum, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is known for its unique properties and health benefits. This plant is valued for its potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum × selago var. intermedium include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The health benefits of this plant are also associated with its ability to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression.
